description: A large Kanban board on the Svelte 5 data grid with thousands of cards per lane kept smooth by board.virtualized, which keeps only the cards in view in the DOM with a fixed cardHeight. A slider scales the board from 1,000 to 50,000 cards, and drag-and-drop and keyboard moves keep working across the whole window.

faq.question: How do I turn on virtualization?
faq.answer: Set virtualized: true in the board config and give cardHeight a fixed pixel height so the lane can compute positions without measuring every card.

faq.question: Does drag-and-drop work with cards that are not rendered?
faq.answer: Yes. Dropping between two visible cards computes the index in the full lane, and a keyboard move scrolls the moving card into view as it travels.

faq.question: Why must cards be a fixed height?
faq.answer: The virtualizer sizes the lane's scroll area from the count times cardHeight; variable heights would require measuring, which is what virtualization avoids.
